snippet.title: Eco Phantoms gameplay (PC Game, 1990)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Eco Phantoms, Dos PC game produced by Splinter Vision LTD in 1990 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/eco-phantoms/6943/
It is a nice game with a sci-fi graphics quite nice. In this game you have to return home on earth in the universe you've explored.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
